families.name: Predictive control
families.blurb: Optimise over a horizon and re-solve: linear MPC on reduced models, nonlinear and contact-implicit MPC on the full body.

families.name: Where classical control runs out

families.name: Learning from pure simulation

families.name: Learning from human and robot data

families.name: Connections back to classical control

families.name: Where learning runs out

families.name: Generative policies

families.blurb: Distributions over trajectories rather than a single action: diffusion policies, flow matching, and inference-time conditioning.

families.name: Multi-modal and foundation models

families.name: Loco-manipulation and interaction

families.name: Emerging methods and classical structure
